body.label: Target
body.html: One adjacent enemy or unattended mundane barrier.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Bludgeoning Damage to an enemy. An unattended barrier instead takes 2 Damage without opposition.

surges.html: After a hit, push the enemy 1 unit.
Deal +1 Damage to a barrier; against an enemy, knock it Prone instead.

rider.title: Adaptation - Titan
rider.html: Assume Siege Frame (upkeep 1): your first push each turn can move an adjacent creature 1 unit sideways instead of directly away. Your Movement is reduced by 1.
